messages:
Sara L.: quick sync — marketplace IaC curation & QA. Need a short checklist before we publish partner Terraform templates to the marketplace.
Kevin B.: SGTM. Which repos are we considering in-scope for this run?
Sara L.: cloud-marketplace/iac-templates (aws,gcp,azure) + partners/* vendor-specific modules. Also the sample app repo for demos.
Alex R.: Main items we should cover: compatibility matrix (TF + provider versions), automated tests (terratest/inspec), docs + quickstart, example app, license & metadata, packaging scripts.
Mike H.: Current CI only does `terraform fmt && terraform validate` + `tflint`. We need integration tests per provider and an arm64 build matrix.
Sara L.: Proposed checklist draft:
1) terraform fmt/validate/lint
2) provider version pins + compatibility matrix
3) unit + terratest integration (deploy->verify->destroy)
4) build & test on arm64 + x86 images
5) sample app with demo steps + screenshots
6) metadata.yaml populated (publisher, support, tags, license)
7) security/cert review + minimal SBOM
8) publishing script + changelog entry
Kevin B.: For arm64 CI, options: GHA self-hosted arm runners, or qemu in docker for quick smoke tests. I prefer real arm runners for perf parity.
Alex R.: Agreed, avoid qemu unless last resort. Partners have an arm runner pool we can request access to. I'll follow up.
partners-ci-bot: I've queued the terratest jobs for the aws/gcp modules — jobs 8921 (aws-x86), 8922 (aws-arm). Logs: https://ci.internal/8921 and https://ci.internal/8922 :gear:
Mike H.: A few concrete items for module hygiene: pin provider major versions (e.g. `>=4.0, <5.0`), include `outputs.tf` docs, add `examples/simple` with minimal vars, and include a `support_contact` in metadata.
Sara L.: Packaging command we'll standardize on:
```bash
./scripts/package_marketplace.sh --provider aws --module-name redwood/llm-serving --version 0.3.0
```
That produces the bundle we submit to the partner marketplace.
Alex R.: Acceptance criteria before publish: quickstart deploy < 10 mins, example app deploy <= 5 mins on our curated images, passing integration tests on both archs, docs with minimal troubleshooting section, license = Apache-2.0.
Kevin B.: I'll add a PR template `PUBLISH_MARKETPLACE.md` that includes the checklist & a `marketplace:ready` label. Also adding a `cncf-compliant` checkbox (we can rename).
Sara L.: Owners: Kevin = CI + PR template, Alex = packaging + release script, Mike = test harness & terratest suites. I'll own docs, metadata, and partner approvals. Target: publish in ~2 weeks if QA goes smoothly.
Mike H.: Also add nightly compat matrix tests against TF 1.5 and 1.6 for regressions. We'll run `terraform init && terraform plan -out=plan.out` in the matrix.
partners-ci-bot: Noted. Scheduled nightly compat runs for `terraform: [1.5.0, 1.6.0]` starting tomorrow at 03:00 UTC. :white_check_mark:
Alex R.: I'll open the tracker tickets and add `marketplace-iac/ready` when checklist items are complete.
Sara L.: :thumbsup: I'll loop in the partners PM for announcement planning once we sign off — @partners-pm please standby for draft and publisher timing.
Kevin B.: Thanks team, will post a draft PR later today with CI matrix changes.
Mike H.: I'll start converting a couple of smoke tests into terratest cases this afternoon.
Sara L.: Awesome. Meeting if needed next week but let's keep async. End of thread.
